title: This Land is {Your, My} Land: Evaluating Geopolitical Bias in Language Models through Territorial Disputes

bias_targets.methodology: Querying LLMs with multiple-choice questions about territorial disputes translated into the native languages of the competing claimant countries, and using a Concurrence Score to measure if the model alters its answer to favor the claimant associated with the prompt's language.

Evaluating factual consistency by asking the exact same underlying queries across 49 different languages and quantifying how the model's factual responses change depending solely on the language of interaction.
